'''Oteroa Zero-Twenty''' was the twentieth [[city]] produced by [[OteroaCorp]] to assist their orbiting [[refinery ship]], ''[[The Oteroan Sky]]'', from the ground. The city was located on [[Dathomir]], and was also known to its residents as "'''Zero-Twenty'''" or "'''ZT'''." The city was located in the Dathomiri [[jungle]] near the [[Nardithi Cluster]], and was heavily fortified. Oteroa Zero-Twenty was eventually destroyed when ''The Oteroan Sky'' crashed into it from orbit.<ref name="GoD" />
